policy: Published API records are explicit minimal provenance projections, not byte-identical original responses. Original API responses remain unchanged externally; their byte counts and SHA-256 values bind each projection. No person attribution is copied.

clippy/workflow-run.json.projection: Only workflow identity, event, head, status, timestamps and URL. Actor, triggering_actor, head_commit author/committer and other account objects omitted.

arm64/workflow-run.json.projection: Only workflow identity, event, head, status, timestamps and URL. Actor, triggering_actor, head_commit author/committer and other account objects omitted.

clippy/workflow-jobs.json.projection: Job identity, descriptive name, head, status, timestamps, runner labels, URL and step status/timestamps only; runner/account objects omitted.

arm64/workflow-jobs.json.projection: Job identity, descriptive name, head, status, timestamps, runner labels, URL and step status/timestamps only; runner/account objects omitted.

clippy/merge-commit.json.projection: Commit SHA, tree SHA, parent SHAs and author/committer timestamps only; attribution names/emails and message omitted.

pr-at-clippy.json.projection: PR number/title and head/base SHA/ref only; all user/account objects, body and review objects omitted.
